name: headscale
title: Headscale
description: Headscale is a self-hosted Tailscale control server: your own mesh VPN with MagicDNS and no account at Tailscale. Set the public URL clients will use (put it behind Traefik), then create a user and keys with docker exec Headscale headscale users create <name> and … preauthkeys create --user <name>; clients join with tailscale up --login-server <url>.

variables.name: PORT_HEADSCALE
variables.label: API port
variables.description: Clients and Traefik reach the control server here

variables.name: HEADSCALE_SERVER_URL
variables.label: Public URL
variables.description: The URL clients log in at — must be reachable from every device (normally the Traefik route)

variables.name: HEADSCALE_BASE_DOMAIN
variables.label: MagicDNS domain
variables.description: Devices become <name>.<this domain>; must differ from the public URL's domain

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
